mentions.name: HS Code Classification AI Agent
mentions.description: This AI agent automates HS/HTS product classification for global trade, using LLMs and RAG to map product descriptions to 6, 8, or 10-digit HS/HTS codes, including country-specific variants supporting WCO, US HTS, and EU CN codes. It classifies products in under 30 seconds with about 90% accuracy on real-world data and includes human-in-the-loop review and overrides.
mentions.problem: Teams lose significant time and money due to product misclassification and resulting customs delays.
mentions.audience: Importers, exporters, and logistics teams that need to classify products for global trade.
mentions.source_excerpt: We built an HS Code Classification AI Agent using SimplAI to help importers, exporters, and logistics teams automate product classification for global trade.

evidence.value: We built an HS Code Classification AI Agent using SimplAI to help importers, exporters, and logistics teams automate product classification for global trade.
